Prottasha is an academic self-management application, not medical treatment. Authentication data and the minimal public pod profile use Firebase. Habits, usage, journals, triggers, and private images remain encrypted on this device. The showcase does not sell data or include advertising analytics. Deleting an account removes the defined local and cloud records through the in-app deletion flow once implemented. Circle is peer support, not professional care.
